title: Social
content:
# Social

Publishing and analytics on 16 platforms bill per connected account, with 2 accounts free and X API calls passed through at cost.

## Price

<span id="connected-accounts" />

| Meter | Included | Then |
|---|---|---|
| Connected accounts | 2 accounts (a $12 monthly credit) | $6 per account for accounts 3 to 10, $3 for 11 to 100, $1 from 101, no cap. Per account per month |
| [X API calls](#x-twitter-api-usage) | None | X's published rate per call, no markup |

Pricing is graduated: each account bills at the rate of the band it falls in. Billing prorates by the day, and accounts count across your whole team.

## What counts as a connected account

Every active connection counts once on this one ladder, and profiles never count.

- Posting accounts: an Instagram account, a Facebook Page, a YouTube channel, a TikTok account. One each.
- Ad accounts (`metaads`, `googleads`, `linkedinads`, `tiktokads`, `xads`, `pinterestads`, `openaiads`, `redditads`, `microsoftads`) count like posting accounts. A Page, its Instagram account and the Meta ad account behind them are 3.
- WhatsApp numbers count once each, on the same ladder, plus their [number fee](/pricing/phone).
- Google, Microsoft and IMAP accounts count once each, whatever areas they grant. A Google account with email and calendar is 1.
- SMS and voice capability on a number never count.
- Profiles are free and unlimited on current plans. See [Profiles](/guides/profiles).

## Example

An agency runs 4 profiles, each with a Facebook Page, an Instagram account and a Meta ad account. That is 12 connected accounts.

| Accounts | Rate | Subtotal |
|---|---|---|
| 1 to 2 (2) | free | $0 |
| 3 to 10 (8) | $6 each | $48 |
| 11 to 12 (2) | $3 each | $6 |
| **12 accounts** | | **$54 per month** |

## X (`twitter`) API usage

X charges per API call. Zernio passes each call through at X's published rate, with no markup. It applies only when an X account is connected. Full table: [docs.x.com](https://docs.x.com/x-api/getting-started/pricing).

| X operation | Rate |
|---|---|
| Posts: Read (analytics, post lookups) | $0.005 per resource |
| Content: Create (publishing a post) | $0.015 per request |
| Content: Create with URL (a post with an http/https link) | $0.200 per request |
| DM: Read | $0.010 per resource |
| DM: Send | $0.015 per resource |

## Limits

- Posts are unlimited, subject to the per-account [rate limits](/guides/rate-limits#posting-velocity-limits). Legacy Stripe and AppSumo plans keep the profile cap they came with.
- A card is needed before the third account. On accounts billed monthly it is also needed before the first X account. See [payment method required](/pricing/payment-method-required).
- On the [prepaid balance](/pricing/balance), connecting X is free. X calls are paid from the balance, so until you add funds the post import and syncs wait, and the dashboard asks you to add funds at your first X post or DM.
- X spend cap: set it in the dashboard, with none until you do. At 80% you get a warning email.
- At 100% every billable X call stops until the period resets or you raise the cap. Posts are refused, and analytics, inbox sync, likes, reposts and follows pause.
- Appears on the invoice per account, itemized to the day.
